name: Combat
desc: Piloting skill, weapon handling, and battlefield awareness. The core combat proficiency — everything else is specialization.

maneuverSlots.desc: Maneuver slots: 1 at level 1, 2 at level 3, 3 at level 6, 4 at level 9

milestones.3: Unlock 2nd maneuver slot + access to Tier 2 maneuvers
milestones.5: Unlock Stance selection (before this: locked to Balanced)
milestones.6: Unlock 3rd maneuver slot + access to Tier 3 maneuvers
milestones.8: Unlock Targeting mode selection (before this: locked to Balanced targeting)
milestones.10: Master Combat: all maneuver positions available, +10% crit chance

notes: THE combat gate. Maneuver slots are the most impactful unlock. Level 5 unlocking stances and level 8 unlocking targeting creates a progression where the player gradually gains control over pre-combat configuration.

name: Resource Gathering
desc: Efficiency in collecting, sorting, and identifying raw materials from the scrapyard.

rareFind.desc: +2% chance of rare material per level

milestones.5: Unlock deep scavenging (access to buried materials)
milestones.7: Unlock material sensing (preview scrap type before collecting)
milestones.10: Master Gatherer: double rare material chance, passive scrap generation

notes: The first skill the player levels. Gathering is available from Phase 2 (sorting station). Muscle and grit make sense — it's physical labor.

name: Mecha Tech
desc: Knowledge of frame assembly, part maintenance, and field modifications. The mechanic's art.

milestones.3: Unlock part condition preview (see exact % before installing)
milestones.5: Unlock field repair during combat (new maneuver-like action)
milestones.7: Unlock overhaul (restore part to 100% condition for materials)
milestones.10: Master Mechanic: parts decay 20% slower, unlock Hayabusa Mk.II blueprint

notes: Directly affects the parts lifecycle. Level 10 milestone unlocks the Hayabusa Mk.II blueprint — narrative payoff for mastering Dad's craft.

name: Crafting & Research
desc: Fabrication techniques, blueprint analysis, and material science. Turning scrap into precision components.

craftQuality.desc: +3% chance of quality bonus on crafted items per level

milestones.5: Unlock reverse engineering (study enemy parts for blueprints)
milestones.7: Unlock experimental crafting (chance of special property on crafted parts)
milestones.10: Master Crafter: all Hayabusa blueprints available, crafted parts get +1 tier

notes: Gates the crafting endgame. Level 10 unlocking all Hayabusa blueprints + tier bonus is the capstone of the player-as-artisan fantasy.

name: Hacking & Cybernetics
desc: Netrunning, system exploitation, and neural interface optimization. The digital edge.

errorTokenChance.desc: +2% chance to apply ERROR token in combat per level

milestones.3: Unlock network scan (reveal enemy loadout before combat)
milestones.5: Unlock system intrusion (disable one enemy weapon for 2 turns)
milestones.7: Unlock neural overclock (temporary +2 to all stats for one combat)
milestones.10: Master Hacker: guaranteed ERROR token on first attack, unlock Cybernetic Bench augments

notes: The 'tech combat' skill. Hacking milestones provide combat utility without being about damage — scanning, disabling, debuffing. Level 10 gatekeeps cybernetic augments (stats beyond the 10 cap).

name: Investigation
desc: Analyzing clues, deduction, and uncovering hidden information. The detective's eye.

clueDetection.desc: +5% chance to find hidden events per level

lootScan.desc: +3% bonus loot from missions per level

eventQuality.desc: +5% better outcomes from random events per level

milestones.3: Unlock zone scouting (preview encounter pool before entering)
milestones.7: Unlock hidden zones (access to secret areas in each Phase)
milestones.10: Master Investigator: all zone secrets revealed, unlock Dad's encrypted journal

notes: The narrative skill. Investigation milestones are about information — knowing what you'll face before facing it. Level 10 unlocks Dad's journal, a key narrative artifact.

name: Social Influence
desc: Diplomacy, intimidation, and commercial negotiation. Words as weapons.

milestones.3: Unlock faction negotiation (better faction mission rewards)
milestones.5: Unlock black market access (Exile vendors without rep requirement)
milestones.7: Unlock corporate contacts (buy Aegis/Kuroda gear at reduced rep threshold)
milestones.10: Master Diplomat: all faction vendors available, NPC mechanic works for free

notes: The economy skill. Level 5 bypassing Exile rep for vendor access is a powerful shortcut. Level 7 reducing rep thresholds for premium gear accelerates endgame. Level 10 making the NPC mechanic free removes a major recurring cost.
